caption: The drawing depicts a single object, an old wooden clamp or vise, centrally placed against a plain, light beige background. The clamp is shown horizontally, with its two rectangular jaws forming a squared "C" shape, and a thick, cylindrical screw with a wooden handle extending to the left side. The screw is threaded and colored in a lighter brown shade than the rest of the clamp, showing wear. The frame of the clamp is composed of dark brown, weathered wood, with visible grain and small metal reinforcements in the form of black diagonal strips fastened with round-headed rivets at the corners. There are no other objects or decorative elements in the composition, leaving negative space around the clamp. The detailed rendering includes shading and highlights, suggesting a realistic, three-dimensional effect. Near the bottom right of the clamp, there is small, faint text that reads "Edwards Anger."
title: Clamp
